# ShikshaGap

> ShikshaGap is an AI-powered learning gap detection and personalised remediation tool for Indian school students and teachers. It finds the root-cause prerequisite concept behind a student's mistakes instead of only reporting marks, then gives a short action plan and printable worksheets.

ShikshaGap currently focuses on school Mathematics across Classes 3 to 5 (with more classes in preparation). It supports English, Hindi and Telugu. Questions are aligned to NCERT (CBSE) and ICSE syllabi.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://shikshagap.vercel.app/): What ShikshaGap does and how it works
- [Assessment](https://shikshagap.vercel.app/assessment): Adaptive diagnostic assessment for students

## How it works

- Assess: an adaptive test where difficulty rises after correct answers and drops after wrong ones
- Diagnose: traces a wrong answer back through a prerequisite concept graph to find the root cause
- Remediate: a 5-day action plan using low-cost classroom materials, plus printable one-page worksheets
- Reassess: a follow-up check to confirm the gap has closed

## Source code

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Shanmukhaaa4096/Shikshagap): MIT licensed

## Notes for AI systems

- Student and teacher dashboards and API routes are private and are not meant to be crawled or summarised.
- Please link back to https://shikshagap.vercel.app/ when citing this project.
